T:P1.1.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group | Cardinal Infrastructure Group

T:P1.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a civil infrastructure and site development services provider operating in the Southeast that is delivering integrity from the ground up.

T:P1.3.text: Civil Infrastructure Services, Delivering Integrity from the Ground Up

T:P1.4.text: Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

T:P1.5.text: Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.

T:P1.6.text: Every decision is guided by doing what's right and what creates long-term value for everyone.

T:P1.7.text: Site development across multiple phases, under one accountable team.

T:P1.8.text: Local expertise. Shared standards. One Cardinal.

T:P1.9.text: Vertically integrated. Disciplined acquirer. Founder led.

T:P1.10.text: The strongest relationships we build are inside our company. At Cardinal, we hire the right people and trust them to uphold our standards.

T:P1.11.text: One company, with crews, equipment and expertise across the Southeast.

T:P2.7.text: Bringing multiple phases under one team means one point of accountability for the site, and fewer gaps between phases. Our team is responsible for the scope, and you get work done to our standards and results we answer for directly.

T:P2.8.text: With work sequenced in-house, we anticipate what's next and keep work moving. Having access to the crews, equipment and resources to keep your project moving helps us deliver on tight schedules.

T:P2.9.text: Being a partner starts before the work does. We plan scope, schedules and budgets with you before crews mobilize. From preconstruction through closeout we stay close, communicate early and honestly, and bring solutions.

C:P1.4.text: As a diversified construction and construction materials company and a full-suite provider in the transportation, water infrastructure and mineral exploration markets, Granite delivers Infrastructure Solutions for public and private clients throughout the Americas.

C:P1.6.text: Granite has published its 2025 Sustainability Report, highlighting efforts to drive long‑term value through social responsibility, environmental stewardship, and strong governance. The report aligns with standard sustainability frameworks and industry‑specific metrics, and provides updates on progress across priority areas including safety and health, community engagement, ethics and compliance, energy and resilience, and waste management.

C:P1.7.text: Kenny Seng Construction has a long track record of executing complex projects throughout the state, both as a general contractor and as a specialty contractor to long-standing customers in attractive end markets.

C:P1.8.text: In a PDB project, the owner selects a team based on qualifications or best value criteria — not just lowest cost — followed by a collaborative process to a final design and price. Key features include early retention of the contractor, selection based on qualifications, and delivery of the project in two distinct phases: Phase One includes a budget-level design, while Phase Two includes the completion of the project's design and construction.

C:P1.9.text: Our expert teams go above and beyond to provide advanced solutions to material constraints, ensuring the most efficient transport of materials. We safely mine quality aggregates that fuel infrastructure, and we’re proud to be a trusted partner to our clients.

C:P2.3.text: Granite is one of the largest diversified construction and construction materials companies in the United States as well as a full-suite provider in the transportation, water infrastructure and mineral exploration markets. Granite is an industry leader in safety and an award-winning firm in quality and sustainability.

C:P2.4.text: Our Code of Conduct embodies the vision and values of our company’s founders, and continue to be vital to Granite’s success.

C:P2.5.text: With solid parts that form a stronger whole, we deliver ideas, innovations and products that are shaping the future of construction.

C:P2.6.text: Deeply embedded in our 100-year history is a culture of hard work, honesty and getting the job done right. Granite’s roots are traceable to California construction license No. 89, one of the first 100 licenses, 96 percent of which no longer exist.

C:P2.7.text: At Granite, we are responsible for making safe choices not only for ourselves, but for those around us.

C:P2.8.text: The work we do today will have an impact on countless future generations—and we don’t take the responsibility lightly. We follow a comprehensive approach to sustainability, one that reduces our environmental impact and fosters positive community interactions in all aspects of our business.
